purpose: Cover US-17702 (bundle refuses and skips): the refusal on an unfrozen tree, the --override write of freeze.override, the delta-impacted skip and the all-impacted refusal; the empty-delta frozen-tree case is byte-for-byte unchanged from 0.29.0.
title: DEFINE step 3 PR 8: rcf build bundle --next refuses, overrides and skips

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next on an unfrozen tree exits 4 and the stderr line names rcf define readiness.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-bundle-next-freeze-gate.test.js::bundle --next (PR 8, AC-17702-1): refuses without a freeze record naming rcf define readiness

testCases.description: rcf build bundle --next --override "hotfix" on an unfrozen tree writes freeze.override { reason, by, at } through saveFreezeRecord and emits a bundle (exit 0).
On a non-empty delta impacting FBS-018, bundle --next skips FBS-018 with the reason on stderr and hands out the next unimpacted actionable FBS.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-bundle-next-freeze-gate.test.js::bundle --next (PR 8, AC-17702-3): skips impacted FBS and hands out the next unimpacted

testCases.description: When every actionable FBS is impacted by the delta and no --override is given, bundle --next refuses with exit 4 and the same message pointing at --override.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-bundle-next-freeze-gate.test.js::bundle --next (PR 8, AC-17702-4): refuses when every actionable FBS is impacted and no override

testCases.description: On a frozen tree with an empty delta the bundle --next output and exit code are byte-for-byte unchanged from 0.29.0 (compared against a captured fixture).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/build-bundle-next-freeze-gate.test.js::bundle --next (PR 8, AC-17702-5): empty delta on a frozen tree is unchanged
